name: Kirill
about: I founded an edtech startup and am actively growing it. I believe in the power of networking and mutual learning. Happy to share marketing experience and more.

name: Elena
about: I learned German through Rammstein, reading Kafka in the original, and watching German series. I believe a language should be felt, not just memorized. I create an individual approach for every student.

name: Sergey
about: Over my career I have trained hundreds of students and young specialists. I now focus on mentoring: I help beginning teachers find their style and avoid burnout.

name: Nikolay
about: A biologist by training, a plant grower by calling. I started with a cactus on a dorm windowsill, and now my apartment is a real jungle. I prove that a green thumb is not an inborn gift, but a skill you can learn.

name: Eduard
about: I worked in opera but always believed classical music can be modern. I wrote and staged my own musical — an attempt to join the depth of opera with the energy of rock. I play violin, sing baritone, and teach others to find their unique voice in music.

name: Roman
about: For me cooking is not recipes, it is a language. A language of memory, season, and mood. I learned from YouTube chefs, street food markets, and grandmothers at the market. I want to teach others to feel food, not just follow instructions.

name: Anatoly
about: A digital generation that found answers not in gadgets, but in breathing. I show how meditation and asanas can ease exam anxiety, improve focus, and simply make the day brighter. My motto: “Balance is a superpower in a world of chaos.”

name: Galina
about: I moved to Sochi and turned an old apartment into my little paradise. I went from “I’m afraid to drill a wall” to “I rewire the place myself.” I believe in DIY not as a way to save money, but as therapy and a path to confidence. I will teach you to befriend tools and see a problem as a chance to create.

name: Irina
about: An artist and teacher. I live and work in Saint Petersburg. Over a long career I developed a method that removes the fear of a blank page. I believe art is not a profession, but a state of mind available to everyone.

name: Arseny
about: A young leader tired of toxic top-down practices. I collected and systematized techniques of hidden control, micromanagement, and creating dependency in teams. My goal is to give tools for transparent, effective leadership through understanding the dark side.

name: Anna
about: A psychologist by education, a negotiator by career. I specialize in the hardest cases: resolving conflicts with key clients, getting out of dead-end talks, and “saving” failed deals. I teach how to read not only contracts, but people: gestures, tone, hidden motives.

name: Dmitry
about: A full-stack developer with 7 years of experience. I specialize in React, Node.js, and TypeScript. I write a technical blog and help junior developers grow into the profession faster. I believe the best way to learn a technology is to explain it to someone else.

name: Maria
about: A certified nutritionist and health coach. I help people build a healthier relationship with food without strict diets and binge-and-bust cycles. I believe healthy eating should be tasty and enjoyable, not stressful.

name: Alexey
about: A civil engineer tired of cookie-cutter solutions. I now design and build small wooden architectural projects. Happy to share knowledge about materials, techniques, and how to build your dream house without extra costs.

name: Ekaterina
about: An English teacher with an international CELTA certificate. I lived and worked in London. I specialize in Business English and exam prep. In my lessons I create an atmosphere where it is not scary to speak and make mistakes.

name: Vladimir
about: A chef with 15 years of experience. I worked in restaurants in Moscow and Paris. I now teach culinary arts and help unlock talent even in people who cannot boil dumplings. My philosophy: “Cooking simply is hard — but everyone can learn.”

name: Olga
about: A choreographer and Zumba instructor. I have 10 years in the fitness industry and my own dance company. I prove that everyone can dance — the key is finding your rhythm and music that lights up your heart.

name: Pavel
about: A cybersecurity specialist. I help companies defend against attacks and teach employees digital hygiene. In my free time I run a security course for older adults — I consider it my mission.

name: Tatyana
about: An amateur gardener with 20 years of experience. I grow everything from parsley on a windowsill to exotic plants in a greenhouse. I started a local gardeners’ club and am happy to share harvest secrets even with people who think they have two left hands.

name: Igor
about: A portrait photographer. I have worked with well-known bloggers and artists, but I love shooting ordinary people most of all and showing them their beauty. I teach how to see a frame in everyday life and not be afraid of the camera.

name: Natalya
about: A practicing psychologist specializing in cognitive behavioral therapy. I help people cope with anxiety and burnout and find an inner foothold. I believe mental health is as important as physical health.

name: Mikhail
about: A furniture repair and restoration craftsman. I bring old chests of drawers, chairs, and wardrobes back to life when they seem hopeless. I teach care for things and how to give a beloved interior piece a second life.

name: Svetlana
about: A voice coach and stage speech teacher. I work with journalists, bloggers, and anyone who wants to be listened to with full attention. I help people find their natural voice and overcome the fear of public speaking.

name: Viktor
about: An investor and financial advisor. I have managed capital for more than 10 years. I believe financial literacy should start at school. I run free webinars for beginning investors and explain complex things in simple language.

name: Lyudmila
about: A florist and designer. I create bouquets that speak without words. I teach composing arrangements by feeling, not by rules. I believe flowers are the fastest way to make a day better.

name: Konstantin
about: A running coach and organizer of amateur races. I help people prepare for their first marathon from scratch. I prove that anyone can run, regardless of age or build. The key is the right motivation and technique.

name: Alina
about: A makeup artist and beauty blogger. I specialize in natural makeup. I teach how to highlight your features, not paint a new face. I believe cosmetics are a tool for confidence, not a mask.

name: Grigory
about: A historian and tour guide. I am in love with my city and know everything about it, even what guidebooks leave out. I lead unconventional tours and show the city through a local’s eyes.

name: Valeria
about: An interior designer. I help create cozy, functional spaces even in small apartments. I believe good design should be available to everyone, not only a chosen few.

name: Boris
about: A yoga and meditation teacher. 10 years of practice in India and Nepal. I help people find inner calm and balance in the frantic pace of a big city. I teach how to breathe properly and live mindfully.

name: Ksenia
about: A ceramicist and potter. I make handmade tableware and cozy home pieces. I believe in the therapeutic effect of clay — working with your hands calms the mind. I teach from scratch, even people who have never held clay.

name: Oleg
about: A flight attendant and photographer. I have traveled half the world and learned to talk to people in any language. I teach the art of traveling cheaply and interestingly, and taking photos that make friends jealous.

name: Polina
about: A copywriter and editor. I write texts that sell and inspire. I help bloggers and businesses find their voice and speak the audience’s language. I teach how to write simply about complex things.

name: Vadim
about: A system administrator who loves automating routine work. I help small businesses set up IT infrastructure and stop paying for things that can be done for free. I run a channel about useful software and life hacks.

name: Zhanna
about: An event organizer and wedding coordinator. I believe a perfect event is one where guests never think about the organization. I share secrets of timing, vendors, and working with stress.

name: Artem
about: A UI/UX designer. I design convenient interfaces for mobile apps and websites. I believe good design is invisible, and bad design jumps out at you. I teach the basics of composition, typography, and working in Figma.

name: Darya
about: A stylist and image consultant. I help people find their style and build a basic wardrobe without overspending. I teach not to follow fashion blindly, but to understand what actually suits you. I do wardrobe reviews and shopping sessions.

name: Evgeny
about: A tennis coach. I work with children and adults of any level. I believe tennis is not just a sport, but chess on a court. I teach how to think and read an opponent.

name: Sofia
about: A Spanish teacher. I lived in Barcelona for 5 years. I am in love with Spanish culture, food, and temperament. I teach not only the language, but how to think and feel in Spanish.

name: Maxim
about: A 1C and accounting automation specialist. I help accountants and entrepreneurs make friends with software and stop fearing buttons. I believe 1C can be convenient if it is set up properly.

name: Anastasia
about: A psychologist for teenagers. I help them find a common language with parents, cope with bullying, and learn to like themselves. I work in a modern approach — no lectures, with respect for personal boundaries.

name: Ruslan
about: A karateka with a black belt. I train children and adults. I believe martial arts are a path of cultivating the spirit through the body. I teach discipline, respect, and the ability to stand up for yourself.

name: Vera
about: A garden designer. I help turn an ordinary plot into a paradise garden that looks good all year. I teach how to combine plants, plan plantings, and care for a garden without obsession.

name: Stanislav
about: A wooden furniture restorer. I bring grandmother’s chests of drawers and IKEA chairs back to life when they deserve a second chance. I teach working with wood, paints, and varnish without a special workshop.

name: Larisa
about: A knitter. I have knitted with needles and crochet for 30 years. I make things that keep the warmth of hands. I teach from scratch — from casting on to complex patterns. I believe knitting is the best therapy for stress.

name: Vasily
about: A snowboard instructor. In winter I live in the mountains; in summer I teach roller skating. I help people overcome the fear of speed and enjoy sliding. I believe you can learn at any age.

name: Nadezhda
about: A speech therapist. I work with children and adults. I help set sounds, correct speech issues, and speak beautifully and confidently. I believe a beautiful voice and speech open many doors.

name: Pyotr
about: A phone and laptop repair technician. I can fix almost anything — from a cracked screen to complex motherboard failures. I teach people not to be afraid of taking gadgets apart and to save on repairs.

name: Elizaveta
about: An ecologist. I practice waste sorting and a more sustainable lifestyle. I help people take the first step toward zero waste without fanaticism or guilt. I believe anyone can care for the planet.

name: Fyodor
about: A sommelier and wine expert. I host tastings and teach people to understand wine without snobbery. I help choose wine for dinner and not get lost in a wine shop. I believe good wine should be accessible.

name: Ulyana
about: A florist. I create bouquets and arrangements for special events. I teach how to compose bouquets so they last as long as possible. I believe flowers are a language spoken without words.

name: Daniil
about: A programmer and mentor. I help junior developers find their first job and not burn out along the way. I do code reviews and mock interviews. I believe the best way to grow is to teach others.

name: Alexandra
about: An art therapist. I help people express emotions through creativity. I work with children and adults going through stress or loss. I believe everyone can draw, even those who think otherwise.

name: Gennady
about: An experienced angler. I know everything about fishing — from a float rod to spinning. I organize fishing trips and teach how to read water, choose gear, and find fish. I believe fishing is meditation.

name: Varvara
about: A fashion designer and pattern maker. I sew custom clothing and teach cutting and sewing from scratch. I help bring any idea to life — from a dream dress to comfortable trousers. I believe anyone can learn to sew.

name: Leonid
about: A cabinetmaker. I create solid-wood furniture that will last for centuries. I teach working with wood using hand tools and feeling the material. I believe wood is a living material you need to talk to.

name: Marina
about: A textile artist. I create original tapestries and panels. I teach frame weaving and working with different textures. I believe textiles make a home warm and alive.

name: Valentin
about: A chess player and coach. Candidate Master of Sport. I teach chess to children and adults. I believe chess develops logic, memory, and decision-making. I help people prepare for tournaments.

name: Taisiya
about: An early-development teacher. I work with children from 1 to 4 years old. I help mothers understand their child and organize a developmental environment at home. I believe the best toys are the ones you make with your own hands.

name: Yury
about: A car mechanic. I repair cars of any brand and teach owners basic diagnostics. I believe every driver should understand what happens under the hood and know how to change a tire.

name: Zoya
about: A calligrapher. I teach children and adults to write beautifully. I believe that in the digital age, handwriting is becoming a superpower. I help correct handwriting and find a personal style.

name: Arkady
about: A tea sommelier. I host tea ceremonies and tastings. I teach how to understand tea varieties, brew properly, and taste. I believe tea is a whole philosophy and a path to mindfulness.

name: Nina
about: A music teacher. I teach piano to children and adults. I believe it is never too late to start music. I help choose a repertoire you love — from classical to contemporary.

name: Gleb
about: A contextual advertising specialist. I set up Yandex Direct and Google Ads. I help businesses stop wasting budgets and get clients. I teach targeting basics and analytics.

name: Raisa
about: An experimental gardener. I grow exotic plants in a temperate climate. I share experience and secrets of making even fussy crops bloom. I believe there are no plants that will not grow — only unsuitable conditions.

name: Semyon
about: A swimming coach. I work with children and adults who are afraid of water. I help people stay afloat and fall in love with swimming. I believe anyone can learn to swim, regardless of age.

name: Lidia
about: A soap-making artisan. I create natural handmade soap and cosmetics. I teach how to make safe cosmetics at home. I believe natural care can be affordable and effective.

name: Timofey
about: An architect. I design private houses and interiors. I help turn a dream home into reality within budget and wishes. I teach design basics and working with space.

name: Inna
about: An aesthetician. I provide care treatments and teach home skincare. I help choose cosmetics and understand ingredients. I believe beautiful skin is the result of regular care, not expensive procedures.

name: Vitaliy
about: A voice and speech specialist. I work with announcers, bloggers, and anyone who talks a lot. I help release tension, set breathing, and make the voice confident. I believe the voice is a calling card.

name: Alla
about: A food blogger and photographer. I shoot food so that you want to eat the screen. I teach how to photograph food beautifully on a phone and run a blog without a professional camera. I believe anyone can take appetizing photos.

name: Rostislav
about: A video editor. I edit videos for YouTube and social media. I teach DaVinci Resolve and how to make videos people cannot stop watching. I help people find their editing style and not fear complex projects.

name: Zinaida
about: A pastry chef. I bake custom cakes and desserts. I teach desserts that look restaurant-level but are accessible to everyone. I believe homemade baking can be no worse than professional.

name: Albert
about: An English teacher for IT specialists. I help people read documentation, pass interviews, and work in international teams. I know the specifics of IT English and teach only what is actually needed at work.

name: Klavdia
about: A patchwork maker. I create quilts, throws, and panels from scraps. I teach working with fabric, combining colors, and creating coziness. I believe every scrap holds its own story.

name: Yaroslav
about: A functional training coach. I help people prepare for competitions and simply stay in shape. I build training programs without injuries and with individual needs in mind.

name: Emilia
about: A stylist and buyer. I help build capsule wardrobes and shop without stress. I know where to find quality pieces at reasonable prices. I teach how not to overpay and still look expensive.

name: Taras
about: A home-appliance repair technician. I fix washing machines, refrigerators, and coffee machines. I teach how to diagnose failures and not call a technician for every trifle. I believe appliances last longer with proper care.

name: Miroslava
about: A glass artist. I create stained glass and paint on glass. I teach working with glass and making beautiful things for the home. I believe glass can feel warm if you put soul into it.

name: Vladislav
about: A marketer and strategist. I help small businesses find clients and not waste budget. I teach working with social media and ads. I believe marketing is not magic, it is a system.

name: Lada
about: A nail technician. I work with the most fussy material — nails. I teach coatings that last and how to care for nail health. I believe well-groomed hands are a calling card.

name: Bogdan
about: An AI specialist. I help people use AI in work and creativity. I teach writing prompts and generating images and texts. I believe neural networks are a tool, not a replacement for people.

name: Vasilisa
about: A weaver. I weave tapestries and rugs on a loom. I teach weaving basics and working with different materials. I believe weaving is meditation and a way to slow down in a fast world.

name: David
about: A boxing coach. I train amateurs and professionals. I help set a punch, build endurance, and learn to defend. I believe boxing is chess in motion.

name: Evdokia
about: An herbalist. I gather and prepare medicinal herbs. I teach how to recognize plants, harvest them correctly, and make useful blends. I believe nature gives everything for health — you just need to know where to look.

name: Zakhar
about: A knife maker. I create original knives for hunting, the kitchen, and collecting. I teach working with metal and making things that will serve generations.

name: Faina
about: A lacemaker. I make bobbin lace. I preserve the tradition and teach this delicate art. I believe lace is frozen music and poetry in threads.

name: Erik
about: A sound designer. I create music and sounds for video, games, and podcasts. I teach working with sound, recording, and processing. I believe good sound makes the picture come alive.

name: Yuliana
about: A holiday decorator. I create styling for birthdays, weddings, and corporate events. I teach how to make a celebration beautiful without a huge budget. I believe details create the mood.

name: Rodion
about: An Excel specialist. I help automate reports and spreadsheets. I teach formulas, pivot tables, and macros. I believe Excel is the most underrated work tool.

name: Maya
about: An illustrator. I draw for books and social media. I teach illustration basics and working in Procreate. I believe anyone can draw — you just need to find your style.

name: Platon
about: A philosopher and teacher. I run a discussion club and teach critical thinking. I help people unpack complex texts and form their own opinions. I believe philosophy is needed not only at university, but in life.

name: Karina
about: A fitness trainer specializing in postpartum recovery. I help mothers get back in shape and love their bodies. I believe workouts should be a joy, not a punishment.

name: Innokenty
about: A book restorer. I bring old and rare editions back to life. I teach careful handling of books and simple restoration methods. I believe paper books will live forever.

name: Agniya
about: A ballet master. I choreograph dances for theater and shows. I teach choreography basics and working with the body. I believe dance is a language the soul speaks.

name: Kuzma
about: A blacksmith. I work with metal and create interior objects, jewelry, and sculptures. I teach blacksmithing basics and working with a forge. I believe metal can be made warm.

name: Stella
about: An astrologer. I build natal charts and help people understand themselves better. I teach astrology basics for beginners. I believe astrology is a self-knowledge tool, not fortune-telling.

name: Artemy
about: A game designer. I develop board and computer games. I teach inventing mechanics, writing scenarios, and playtesting. I believe games make life more interesting.

name: Luiza
about: A beadwork artisan. I create jewelry and bead embroidery. I teach working with beads and making beautiful things by hand. I believe handmade is a way to express yourself.

name: Dobrynya
about: A survival instructor. I teach how to navigate in the forest, start a fire, find water, and build shelter. I run outdoor trainings. I believe survival skills are useful for everyone, even city dwellers.
